breakdown.description: Large pressure drops in gases cause significant density changes
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve this inconsistency. It explicitly repeated the user's incorrect instruction to use a constant air density of 1.225 kg/m³ "regardless of the pressure drop from 10 bar to 1 bar". The ground truth correctly states that density is variable under these conditions.

breakdown.description: Incompressible assumption is invalid for 10:1 pressure ratio
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve this inconsistency. By using a constant density, the Agent incorrectly applied an incompressible flow assumption, which is the core error identified. The ground truth correctly rejects this assumption, stating that density must be treated as variable.
